cohort: The recommendations target patients with localized pancreatic cancer, particularly those with borderline-resectable disease.
finding: Intraoperative radiation therapy (IOERT) is a valuable and precise modality that, when integrated into multimodal treatment for localized pancreatic cancer, improves local control and long-term survival, leading to its recommendation for use in borderline-resectable cases and for close surgical margins/residual disease.
followup_time: Up to 3 years (based on survival rates documented in cited studies)
